text: Imagine waking up… and insects are the size of humans.
A giant spider crawls across your window.
And something behind you starts moving.
Within hours, the world collapses.
Ants rip apart cars. Wasps swarm the skyscrapers.
Beetles smash through buildings.
The army opens fire. The insects don't retreat.
A family hides in a locked supermarket.
The lights go out.
Something crawls across the ceiling.
A little girl looks up… and hundreds of eyes look back.
One week later, the cities are silent.
Roads are covered in webs.
But scientists find something worse.
Every colony is moving to the same place.
Deep underground lies their queen.
Bigger than a skyscraper.
Laying thousands of eggs.
And the eggs… are shaped like humans.
They weren't invading our world.
They were preparing to replace us.
And the first eggs are hatching.
The survivors lock the last shelter.
The cameras show nothing inside.
Then… scratching in the vents.
A flashlight. Two enormous eyes.
The radio whispers: "Don't let it out."
